en: The postcard features three black-and-white photographs. The main image at the top shows the facade of a building labeled 'Hotel zum braunen Hirschen.' The two smaller images below depict interior shots: one of a dining or restaurant room, the other a vaulted dining hall (possibly a banquet room). There is a prominent oval purple stamp on the upper right corner with hotel information in German.
